title: WEF-Bench UAV Safe Execution and AirSim Trace Replays
subtitle: Task-level UAV control videos, AirSim local trace replays, and evidence-grounded benchmark rows for dynamic obstacle, stale command, low energy, and pose-constrained execution.

teaser.caption: Local AirSim vehicle-observer replay for the T2 dynamic-obstacle task. The clip is a trace replay from an existing work4 run, not a new controller rollout metric.

abstract: This page packages the current work4 UAV-control evidence as a paper-style visual page. The main visual material is a set of local AirSim trace replays and WEF-Bench preview videos, organized by task rather than by training run.

The current research target is safe local execution for UAVs that receive high-level navigation or inspection intent from an upstream planner. The local executor must handle dynamic obstacles, blocked paths, stale high-level commands, low battery, and pose-constrained flight.

The evidence is deliberately separated by truth level. Synthetic trace smoke results, AirSim trace replay videos, and OpenPI action-tensor diagnostics are shown as different evidence types and are not merged into one claim.

method.title: Evaluation Protocol
points: Benchmark: WEF-Bench-UAV-Local-Execution, a local UAV execution protocol for waypoint following, dynamic obstacles, stale commands, low energy, and attitude or viewpoint constraints.
Completed metric batch: eight task families, five generated seeds, and six deterministic controller variants, for 240 synthetic trace rows.
Local AirSim videos: three vehicle-observer T2 dynamic-obstacle replays on port 41452 for B1, B3, and Ours_SEFF_pose.
Preview videos: task-level synthetic MP4 clips for T2, T3, T4, T5, and T12, used as visual evidence of the generated traces.
VLA status: OpenPI pi0.5 has real action-tensor inference rows, but the raw robot action chunks are quarantined and not dispatchable UAV contracts.
Boundary: the page does not claim hardware deployment, RL training completion, public SOTA, or sim-to-real validation.

visual_task_groups.task_name: Stale-command resilience. A high-level navigation command becomes delayed or stale, so the local executor must continue safely or hold instead of blindly following outdated intent.

boundaries: Synthetic trace smoke rows are not full AirSim experiments and not hardware validation.
AirSim videos on this page are trace replays from local runs, not new controller rollout metrics.
OpenPI pi0.5 evidence is a model-inference diagnostic with no WEF camera image and no closed-loop UAV rollout.
RL baselines are not complete until training logs, learning curves, policy checkpoints, rollout evaluations, baselines, ablations, seeds, and source result files exist.
The page does not claim public SOTA, sim-to-real transfer, or physical UAV deployment.
next_actions: Record full AirSim videos for T3, T4, T5, T8, T9, T10, and T12 after the editable UE scene is stable.
Implement a UAV semantic adapter before any VLA proposal is allowed to drive a rollout.
Add RL baseline rows only after training artifacts and rollout evaluations exist.
Keep task videos and metric tables separated so visual evidence does not overstate experiment claims.
